note: Official trophy names, descriptions and grades as PlayStation publishes them (via Exophase and PSNProfiles, which agree on all 55). Guides are written in the author's own words. 'hidden' marks trophies PlayStation hides until earned, following PSN practice for story trophies. 'missable' flags are inferred from the official descriptions: one-time story missions and partner-gated moments; whether missions can be replayed was not confirmed at launch, so treat the flags as a caution, not a guarantee.

trophies.guide: The platinum unlocks automatically once the other 54 trophies are earned. There is no separate task: work the roadmap in order, story first, then strangers and activities, then collectibles and money, and clean up 100% completion last.
trophies.name: Vice Got a Price!

trophies.guide: Finish the opening mission, Gone Fishing, which introduces Lucia and Jason. It is the first story mission, so it unlocks in the natural course of playing; follow the on-screen objectives and it cannot be skipped past.
trophies.name: Just Like Paradise

trophies.guide: Play through Chapter 1 to its final mission. Chapter trophies unlock on completion of the chapter's last story mission, so keep following the main story path and this lands on its own.
trophies.name: Paradise Lost

trophies.guide: Play through Chapter 2 to its final mission. Like the other chapter trophies, it unlocks when the chapter's story is done; there is no side requirement, just finish the chapter.
trophies.name: T**s Ass Drug Money

trophies.guide: Play through Chapter 3 to its final mission. Keep to the main story; the trophy pops the moment the chapter closes.
trophies.name: Vice City, Baby!

trophies.guide: Play through Chapter 4 to its final mission. This is the last chapter trophy before the finale; finishing the chapter is all it asks.
trophies.name: Top Of The World, Ma

trophies.guide: Finish the game's final story mission. It unlocks when the credits roll on the main story; side content can wait until after, so do not let collectibles slow the story down if you want this early.
trophies.name: You Gotta Know When to Get Off

trophies.guide: Complete the story mission Breakfast Run. Named story missions happen once in the story, so do this one when it appears rather than leaving it; if the game offers mission replay, a failed attempt can be retried from the replay menu, but do not count on replay being available before launch details are confirmed.
trophies.name: Trust

trophies.guide: Complete the story mission The Cartel Heist. It is a set-piece heist mission in the main story; play it when it unlocks and finish it, and the trophy follows. Treat it as one-time: do not skip past it hoping to return later.
trophies.name: Break the Bank

trophies.guide: Complete the story mission Child's Play. It appears once in the story flow; take it when it shows up on the map and see it through to the end of the mission.
trophies.name: Family Matters

trophies.guide: Complete the story mission Headliners. A one-time story mission: play it when it unlocks and finish it; the trophy is tied to completing that mission, not to any optional objective inside it.
trophies.name: DWNFALL

trophies.guide: Complete the story mission VCIA Takedown, set at Vice City International Airport. Finish the mission in full when it appears in the story; it is a named one-time mission, so do not leave it unfinished.
trophies.name: Hi-Jacked

trophies.guide: Complete the story mission Operation Savage Glory. Like the other named missions, it happens once in the story; play it when it unlocks and complete it to earn the trophy.
trophies.name: Snow Storm

trophies.guide: Reach 100% completion on the in-game stats screen. That means the full story, all stranger and side missions, all activities and collectibles the checklist counts, and the stunt and challenge totals. Save this for last: it is the final cleanup trophy before the platinum, and the tracker's progress bar shows what is still open.
trophies.name: A Long Road

trophies.guide: Complete 250 stunts across Leonida: jumps, near misses, airtime and other stunt moves the game counts. Stunts build up through normal driving if you keep the car airborne and close to traffic, but the fastest route is to repeat stunt jumps at spots you know. Check the in-game stats for your running total.
trophies.name: Cunning Stunts

trophies.description: Try each type of activity once.
trophies.guide: Sample every activity type in the game at least once: racing, fishing, the shooting range, drone races, arcade games, bowling, meditation, hunting and the rest. You do not need to win or finish them all, just try each type once; the tracker lists them under Activities so you can tick off what you have tried.
trophies.name: Master of None

trophies.description: Earn a gold medal in all Shooting Range challenges.
trophies.guide: Earn a gold medal in all 42 Shooting Range challenges. Go to a shooting range (Ammu-Nation) and work through each challenge with the required weapon; gold means beating the score threshold, so learn each challenge's target pattern first, then go for score. Use the weapon the challenge asks for and take the steady shots over fast ones.
trophies.name: The Shootist

trophies.description: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every location.
trophies.guide: Win a Top Fun drone race at every drone race location. Each location has its own course; learn the gates, cut corners where the course allows, and keep the drone low and fast. You must win at each location, not just finish, so repeat a course until the win lands.
trophies.name: Top Fun

trophies.guide: Win 20 different races. Races count per event, so winning the same race twice does not add to the total; you need 20 distinct race events won. Work through the race list across Leonida, and pick a fast, stable car for the longer circuits.
trophies.name: Earn Cash, Not Kudos

trophies.description: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge.
trophies.guide: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge. Find the fishing challenge, then out-fish Cal by landing the better catch; fishing is a timing mini-game, so watch the line tension and reel in when the fish tires. If you lose, challenge him again until the win comes.
trophies.name: Baited My Tackle

trophies.guide: Complete any arcade game to its end. Visit an arcade, pick a cabinet, and play it through to completion; you do not need a high score, just a finished run. Any of the arcade games counts.
trophies.name: Stick Fiddler

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Andy.
trophies.guide: Complete Andy's mission strand through to his final mission. Stranger missions unlock as you meet the character in the world; follow Andy's strand to its end. His final mission appears once, so take it when it shows and finish it.
trophies.name: Road to Rehabilitation

sources.name: GTA Wiki — GTA VI stranger missions

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Kenton.
trophies.guide: Complete Kenton's mission strand through to his final mission. Meet Kenton in the world, work through his strand, and take his final mission when it appears; it is a one-time stranger finale.
trophies.name: This Was No Boat Accident

sources.name: GTA Wiki — GTA VI stranger missions

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Billy.
trophies.guide: Complete Billy's mission strand through to his final mission. Follow Billy's strand to its end and play the final mission when it unlocks; like the other stranger finales, it appears once.
trophies.name: The Lone Rider

sources.name: GTA Wiki — GTA VI stranger missions

trophies.description: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across the state of Leonida.
trophies.guide: Complete 8 full stranger mission strands across Leonida. Strangers appear as markers in the world; each strand is several missions ending in a finale. There are more than 8 strands, so pick the ones you find first and finish 8 of them completely; a strand only counts when its final mission is done.
trophies.name: Strangers & Freaks

sources.name: GTA Wiki — GTA VI stranger missions

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Randy.
trophies.guide: Complete Randy's mission strand through to his final mission. Work through Randy's strand and take the finale when it appears; it is a one-time stranger finale, so do not leave it undone.
trophies.name: Supply & Demand

sources.name: GTA Wiki — GTA VI stranger missions

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Tyrone.
trophies.guide: Complete Tyrone's mission strand through to his final mission. Follow Tyrone's strand to its end and play the finale when it unlocks; like the other stranger finales, it appears once.
trophies.name: Spin On This!

sources.name: GTA Wiki — GTA VI stranger missions

trophies.description: Meditate at every spot across Leonida.
trophies.guide: Meditate at every meditation spot across Leonida. Meditation spots are scenic points marked in the world; visit each one and use the meditate prompt. There is no timer, so take them in any order, and use the map to sweep a region at a time so none is left behind.
trophies.name: Positive Mental Attitude

trophies.description: Hunt a unique animal for Bret.
trophies.guide: Hunt a unique animal for Bret. Bret's hunting strand asks for a specific rare animal; track it in the wilds outside the city, approach quietly, and take the shot cleanly. Unique animals are one of a kind, so do not scare it off and lose the trail.
trophies.name: Fair Game

trophies.guide: Complete 3 full collectible card sets. Cards are hidden around Leonida; each set needs every card in it, so collect methodically and trade duplicates if the game allows. Three complete sets, not just three cards, is what counts.
trophies.name: Don't Touch My Deck

trophies.guide: Use the WAiNK feature at 100 different locations. WAiNK is the in-game photo/sharing feature; open it at landmarks, businesses and scenic spots across Leonida and post from each. The count is per location, so the same spot twice does not add to it.
trophies.name: You WAiNKer!

trophies.guide: Complete 50 challenges. Challenges are the game's side objectives, spread across driving, combat, exploration and activities; each one you finish adds to the total. Work through the challenge list in the pause menu and pick off the easy ones first to build the count.
trophies.name: One Last Thing

trophies.description: Lose a 4 star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat.
trophies.guide: With your partner beside you, build a 4-star wanted level, then lose the cops and escape. Do this while your partner is still available in the story, because partner availability can end later; pick a quiet area with good escape routes, lose line of sight, and stay hidden until the stars clear.
trophies.name: Hot Together

trophies.description: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level.
trophies.guide: With your partner, rob 3 shops in a row without losing your wanted level. Plan a route between three close shops, keep the robberies quick, and do not let the wanted level drop between them. Do it while your partner is available in the story; partner-gated trophies are the ones most likely to be missed.
trophies.name: Retail Therapy

trophies.guide: Discover 100 different vehicles. Every new vehicle you drive counts toward discovery, so drive everything you see: cars, bikes, boats, trucks and anything else on the road. The tracker counts distinct vehicles, so repeats add nothing; sweep car parks and traffic in different districts.
trophies.name: Whip It Good

trophies.description: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus.
trophies.guide: Take down 5 enemies during one use of Combat Focus. Combat Focus is the slow-aim mode; trigger it in a fight with at least 5 enemies close together, then land the kills before the focus ends. Pick a busy firefight and line the shots up while time is slowed.
trophies.name: Gunslinger

trophies.description: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA.
trophies.guide: Make an unscheduled departure at Vice City International Airport: steal a plane at the airport and take off without a scheduled flight. Get to the runway area, board any plane, and get airborne; the trophy is about the departure itself, not the destination.
trophies.name: Catch Me If You Can

trophies.guide: Get into a Rhino tank and cause mayhem with it. Rhinos appear at military areas and in high wanted-level responses; commandeer one and the trophy follows. The description is a joke about the heat inside a tank, not a separate objective.
trophies.name: Challenging Tank

trophies.description: Rob a jewelry store without being detected.
trophies.guide: Rob a jewelry store without being detected. Go in quiet: avoid cameras and guards, take the goods, and leave before anyone raises the alarm. A stealth approach with a silenced weapon and a quick exit works; if you are spotted, leave and try again.
trophies.name: Sneakthief

trophies.guide: Rob 5 bank vaults and escape after each one. Bank vault robberies are bigger jobs than shop robberies; plan the getaway before you go in, and count each vault you clear and escape from. Five in total, in any order, across the game.
trophies.name: Maximum Withdrawal

trophies.description: Rob an Armored Truck and escape.
trophies.guide: Rob an armored truck and escape. Armored trucks drive set routes around Leonida; intercept one, stop it, take the cash, and get away before the police box you in. Any armored truck counts.
trophies.name: A Classic Blitz Play

trophies.guide: Explore every region of Leonida: Vice City, the beaches, the swamps, the Keys and the countryside. The map fills in as you travel, so drive, fly and sail into every corner until no fog remains on the map. The tracker counts this as exploration; pair it with the collectible sweep to save time.
trophies.name: The Goodtime State

trophies.description: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each gang.
trophies.guide: Rob an illegal operation belonging to each gang in Leonida. Every gang runs its own operations; hit one operation per gang and the trophy counts each gang once. Learn which gang holds which turf, then work through the list gang by gang.
trophies.name: Pest Control

trophies.description: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach.
trophies.guide: Go to a bar on Ocean Beach, order a cocktail, and enjoy the view. It is a small moment trophy: sit at the bar, buy the drink, and let the scene play. Any bar with a beach view on Ocean Beach counts.
trophies.name: In The Beginning…

trophies.description: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style.
trophies.guide: Drive a car through the front of a vehicle showroom and smash your way out. Pick a showroom, get a car inside or drive one straight through the glass, and keep going; the trophy is a nod to the classic GTA showroom escape.
trophies.name: Capital Offense

trophies.description: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley.
trophies.guide: Bowl at the Kolt & Associates bowling alley and complete a follow-through. Go to the alley, play a game of bowling, and finish your throw properly; the trophy is about playing the game through at that specific alley.
trophies.name: Let’s Go Bowling

trophies.guide: Build a partnership with mass appeal. This reads as a story moment tied to Lucia and Jason working together and winning people over; play the story and it should land when the partnership hits its stride. If it has not popped by the finale, check the stranger and side strands for partnership work.
trophies.name: Personal Best

trophies.guide: Make a story choice and live with it. The game presents a decision point where you choose one path over another; pick either side and the trophy pops for having made the choice. Because a choice can lock the other path, make a manual save before the decision so you can see the other outcome if you want it.
trophies.name: Actions Speak Louder

trophies.guide: Succeed on a second attempt at something that failed the first time. This reads as a retry trophy: fail a mission, challenge or attempt once, then succeed on the next try. If it does not pop naturally, replay a mission you failed and finish it on the second run.
trophies.name: Bad Luck, I Guess

trophies.guide: Trigger a surprising story event. The vague description marks a scripted moment in the story that catches the characters off guard; keep playing the main story and it will happen on its own. There is nothing to grind for this one, just the story.
trophies.name: The Truth Is Out There

trophies.description: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by.
trophies.guide: Knock bowling pins over with a melee drive-by. At the bowling alley, drive a vehicle past the pins and hit them with a melee attack from the vehicle; a drive-by swing that topples the pins is what counts. Line the car up with the pins and swing as you pass.
trophies.name: Ten Pin

trophies.description: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts.
trophies.guide: Launder $250,000 of Marked Bills through your contacts. Marked Bills come from robberies and heists; take them to a contact who cleans money and launder them in batches until the total hits $250,000. It is a running total, so keep laundering every batch you earn.
trophies.name: Dime on the Dollar

trophies.guide: Spend $100,000 across all shops in Leonida. Buy clothes, weapons, food, car upgrades and anything else sold in shops; the total adds up across every shop, so normal spending through the game gets you most of the way. If you are short at the end, buy expensive car mods to close the gap.
trophies.name: Treat Yo Self

trophies.guide: Buy every garage property in Leonida. Garages are properties you purchase to store vehicles; visit each one for sale and buy it. You need the cash first, so pair this with the money-making of the later game, and check the property list to see which garages are still unowned.
trophies.name: Little Boxes

trophies.description: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app.
trophies.guide: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app. The app lets you register vehicles you own or find; open it, add a vehicle, and repeat until 10 are registered. Use cheap or found vehicles if you do not want to spend on ten cars.
trophies.name: On the Spot
